Hṛdika : m. (pl.): Name of a people.

Kṛtavarman designated as the great chariot-fighter of Hṛdikas (hṛdikānāṁ mahāratham) 8. 18. 62 (Hṛdika, father of Kṛtavarman, perhaps also designated after the people's name).
